'''Boniface N'Dong''' (born 3 September 1977) is a Senegalese former [[basketball]] player and current coach. Born in [[M'Bour]], Senegal, he also holds [[German nationality law|German citizenship]].

==Professional career==
N'Dong had previously planned to enter the [[NCAA]] with an American college in hopes to gain major exposure. However, due to his weight being under what American colleges were looking for at the time, those plans were ultimately aborted. Instead, as a 21-year-old, N'Dong had to look into an alternative plan for increasing his talents due to Senegal's professional leagues performing less-than-par of expectations for him. During that time, [[Dallas Mavericks]] agent Amadou Fall recommended that he train with [[Dirk Nowitzki]]'s former club and improve his skills there.<ref>[http://basketball.de/weltweit/europa/ratteldorfs-finest Ratteldorf’s Finest] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181107185532/http://basketball.de/weltweit/europa/ratteldorfs-finest |date=2018-11-07 }} {{in lang|de}}</ref> Sometime in early 1999, N'Dong signed with the SpVgg Rattelsdorf in Germany for one-and-a-half seasons of play there. After being undrafted in 1999, he continued training for the next three years in the TSV Tröster Breitengüßbach to further improve his game. In 2003, he would finally improve his skills to play in the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] professional league with the [[Brose Bamberg|TSK uniVersa Bamberg]]. After playing a season there, he would sign a two-year deal with the [[JDA Dijon Basket|Dijon Basket]] out in the [[LNB Pro A]]. During this time, he would gain further exposure from NBA scouts.

The [[2005–06 NBA season]] would be the first and only NBA season for the 28-year-old 7-ft [[Center (basketball)|center]] to play in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]]. During this season, N'Dong barely played any notable parts with the team, appearing in 23 games with a 7-minute per game average, starting only once for them. However, the Clippers would ultimately have a surprising season under their belt in his sole season there, making it to the Western Conference semifinals for the first time in franchise history, barely upsetting the [[Phoenix Suns]] in the process. In December 2006, he signed with the Russian club [[Spartak St. Petersburg]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.noticias.info/archivo/2006/200612/20061205/20061205_246891.shtm |title=N'Dong joins Spartak. |access-date=2007-07-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090703050413/http://www.noticias.info/archivo/2006/200612/20061205/20061205_246891.shtm |archive-date=2009-07-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref> N'Dong moved to the [[Liga ACB|Spanish ACB]] league later that season and signed with [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja Málaga]] for the 2006–07 [[2007 ACB Playoffs|ACB League play-offs]] to replace the injured [[Daniel Santiago]]. On 14 July 2007 he re-signed with Malaga on a one-season contract. He has also played with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] [[NBA Summer League]] squad in 2007.

In 2009, he signed a two-year contract worth [[Euro|€]]3.2 million with the [[Liga ACB|Spanish league]] club [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]].<ref>[http://www.solobasket.com/contenidos/ndong/hecho/regal/f/c/barcelona/2/anos/3/2/millones/euros/c-21752.html Solobasket.com N'Dong signs with FC Barcelona.]</ref> In 2011, he signed a one-year extension with [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|Regal Barcelona]].

In the summer of 2012, he signed a one-year contract with [[Galatasaray S.K. (men's basketball)|Galatasaray Medical Park]].<ref>[http://encestando.es/confirmado-el-fichaje-de-ndong-por-el-galatasaray-turco-el-barca-pierde-a-su-pivot-y-debe-recomponer-su-plantilla/ Confirmado el fichaje de Ndong por el Galatasaray: el Barça debe recomponer la plantilla]</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Ndong no continuará en el Barça Regal|url=http://www.fcbarcelona.es/baloncesto/barca-regal/detalle/noticia/ndong-no-continuara-en-el-barca-regal|publisher=Regal Barcelona Official Website|access-date=5 August 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Boniface Ndong Galatasaray Medical Park'ta|url=http://www.galatasaray.org/basketbol/erkek/haber/14128.php|publisher=Galatasaray SK|access-date=11 August 2012}}</ref> On 16 June 2013, the day after Galatasaray won the [[2012–13 Turkish Basketball League|2012–13]] league championship, he announced that he was going to retire.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ntvspor.net/haber/gunun-haberleri/89402/ndong-zirvede-birakti|title=Ndong zirvede bıraktı}}</ref>

==National team career==
N'dong helped the [[Senegal national basketball team|Senegal national team]] get the silver medal at the [[FIBA Africa Championship 2005]] in [[Algeria]], a competition he won the MVP award.

==Coaching career==
From 2015 until 2019, N'Dong was an assistant coach for [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja Málaga]]. In autumn 2020, N'Dong took over as the head coach of the [[Senegal national basketball team]] during the qualifiers for [[AfroBasket 2021]].<ref>{{cite news |title=AfroBasket 2021 - Team Profile: Senegal |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/afrobasket/2021/news/2021-afrobasket-team-profile-senegal |access-date=28 August 2021 |work=FIBA.basketball |language=en}}</ref>
